acceptance_checks.when: the durable index is deleted and magicite sync --project-root . is run
acceptance_checks.then: every engram ingests under the strict lint profile with zero validation errors and the registered count equals the number of .egr.md files on disk
acceptance_checks.verify_method: rm -f .spectra/engrams/skill-graph.db* && uv run magicite sync --project-root . -> synced: 16, validation_errors: [], dangling: []

acceptance_checks.when: every declared needs, composes, and inhibits target is resolved against the set of registered engram names
acceptance_checks.then: there are zero dangling declared edges
acceptance_checks.verify_method: sync output dangling: [] plus a direct edge query -> 12 depends_on + 5 inhibits, all provenance=declared, all resolved

acceptance_checks.when: route() is called with questions a maintainer would actually ask
acceptance_checks.then: the intended engram appears in its own top-3 candidates for at least 80% of probes, as a wiring sanity check and NOT a retrieval evaluation
acceptance_checks.verify_method: uv run python scripts/dogfood_session.py -> 4/4 probes in top-3, 3/4 at rank 1

acceptance_checks.given: a live stdio MCP session against the local tree
acceptance_checks.when: the capability set is exercised in order (introspect, route, load_skill_body, signal_use, signal_outcome, session_end, consolidate, checkpoint, flag_dead, sync, export, nucleate, sharpen, promote, archive)
acceptance_checks.then: every call returns a non-error result and the JSON-RPC transcript is recorded under the change folder

acceptance_checks.when: a signal call carries the matching secret as adapter_token, versus a wrong secret, the literal string hook_verified, no token, or a server with no token configured
acceptance_checks.then: only the matching secret against a token-configured server yields signal_tier 2; every other combination yields tier 1
acceptance_checks.verify_method: uv run python scripts/dogfood_tier_probe.py -> 5/5 assertions pass

acceptance_checks.verify_method: uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy src && uv run pytest -q --cov=src/magicite --cov-fail-under=70 && uv run pytest -q -m acceptance && uv run magicite tools
